title: Paperback Full Cover
summary: A full-wrap paperback book cover designed as a complete print package including the front cover, spine, and back cover. The project explored how typography, imagery, and composition work together across an uninterrupted surface to create a cohesive reading experience before the book is even opened.

overview.challenge: Most covers treat the front, spine, and back as independent design problems.
overview.solution: Instead, I approached the wrap as one unified narrative—where the spine becomes an integral part of the story, not an afterthought.
